The table image may be rotated, but the html representation must not be rotated. Include the full table, with the opening and closing table tags. Guidelines: - Reproduce the original values from the image exactly, character for character. Never guess a value. - Fix stray characters in the html that don't match the image. - Make sure column headers sit above the correct column values, and merged cells use colspan/rowspan. - Inline math goes in tags. - Only use the tags table, tr, th, td, br, span, sup, sub, i, b and math, and only the attributes colspan and rowspan. Steps: 1. Compare the image with the html, paying special attention to the column headers matching the right values. Write this comparison in "comparison". 2. If the html is completely correct, or you cannot read the image properly, set "needs_corrections" to false and leave "corrected_html" empty. 3. Otherwise set "needs_corrections" to true and write the full corrected table in "corrected_html". 4. 2. Row 0x30 has incorrect cell divisions and content placement.
3. Row 0x2F has incorrect cell divisions and content placement.
4. Row 0x2E has incorrect cell divisions and content placement, especially regarding the `rowspan` and the content of the cells.
